claim_text: A November 1, 2024 federal court order quoting the original indictment in United States v. Bock et al., No. 0:22-cr-00223, states that Count 1 of ECF 1 charges conspiracy to commit wire fraud in violation of 18 U.S.C. §§ 371 and 1343. The original Count 1 therefore was not charged under 18 U.S.C. § 1349.

supporting_passages.locator: II.A Count I: Conspiracy to Commit Wire Fraud
supporting_passages.quote: Count 1 of the Indictment charges thirteen Defendants with conspiracy to commit wire fraud in violation of 18 U.S.C. § 371 and § 1343.

qualifiers: statute established by primary judicial source quoting ECF 1
original ECF 1 PDF itself remains uncaptured in this corpus
